messages.content: The response must contain between 77 and 99 words. Patient says their neck feels stiff and swollen around throat area and throat feels sore. As a doctor, you can see no signs of swelling, and it's confirmed not to be a respiratory infection. What are the possible causes from the data you can gather?

message.content: As a doctor, I note no visible swelling, which is reassuring. With no respiratory infection confirmed, here are possible causes: muscular strain or cervical tension from poor posture or repetitive strain, common with prolonged screen use. Anxiety or stress can manifest as perceived throat swelling and tightness without physical changes. Acid reflux (LPR) may irritate your throat, causing soreness and tightness. We should also consider mild lymphatic congestion not yet visible on exam, or a reactive cervical spine joint issue. I'd recommend gentle stretches, monitoring, and possibly imaging if symptoms persist beyond a week.
